gaps.explanation: Statement pp6-7 (Statement of Revenues, Expenditures, and Changes in Fund Balances - Modified Accrual Basis - Governmental Funds) total revenues per fund vs the cash-basis budgetary comparison schedules used for detail (pp15-19, each detail set sums to its printed Total resources): Street 1,626,446 vs 1,586,156 (p15) = 40,290; CDBG 455,325 vs 503,471 (p16) = -48,146; Debt Service 5,795 vs 5,539 (p17) = 256; LB 357 1,564,125 vs 1,445,679 (p18) = 118,446; Capital Projects 5,704,288 vs 5,702,404 (p19) = 1,884. General Fund (14,098,573, departments pp22-23) and Other Funds (1,466,486 = nonmajor combining pp20-21: Aviation 708,340 + Keno 1,597 + Sinking 504,468 + E911 8,894 + TIF 243,187) agree. 40,290 - 48,146 + 256 + 118,446 + 1,884 = 112,730 = gap. Cash basis vs modified accrual; no fix.

Statement pp6-7 total expenditures (modified accrual) vs cash-basis budgetary schedules: Street 1,933,186 vs 1,908,645 (p15) = 24,541; Debt Service 692,907 vs 685,332 (p17) = 7,575; LB 357 1,201,758 vs 911,056 (p18) = 290,702 (statement capital outlay 640,033 vs schedule 382,584, interest 168,368 vs 135,115); Capital Projects 1,123,759 vs 1,068,601 (p19) = 55,158. CDBG 427,429 (p16), General Fund 11,379,755 and Other Funds 1,207,627 (Aviation 853,238 + Keno 13,651 + Sinking 37,332 + TIF 303,406) agree. 24,541 + 7,575 + 290,702 + 55,158 = 377,976 = gap. Cash basis vs modified accrual; no fix.

The statement prints transfers only net per fund column (pp6-7 'Transfer from (to) other funds': General (2,193,955), Street 1,059,123, Debt Service 1,162,550, Capital Projects (106,082), Other Funds (23,270); Total (101,634)); JSON transfers_in = 1,059,123 + 1,162,550 = 2,221,673. Detail records gross per department / fund: General Fund departments schedule pp22-23 prints General department (8,798,168) and transfers in to 13 departments totalling 6,604,213 (Capital Projects 124,539, Auditorium 127,216, Parks 560,154, Police 2,254,882, Community Center 414,115, Aquatic Center 233,869, Ball Park 169,348, Senior Center 17,741, Convention Center 394,420, Fire/EMS 1,478,744, Library 556,039, Police Pension 72,797, Fire Pension 200,349; net -2,193,955 = statement), and the nonmajor combining statement pp20-21 prints Aviation 53,300 in, Sinking (59,244) and TIF (17,326) out (net -23,270 = statement Other Funds). Detail in = 6,604,213 + 1,059,123 + 1,162,550 + 53,300 = 8,879,186; excess 6,604,213 + 53,300 = 6,657,513 = gap. Gross vs net presentation; no fix.

Same netting as transfers_in. JSON transfers_out = General 2,193,955 + Capital Projects 106,082 + Other Funds 23,270 = 2,323,307 (net fund columns, pp6-7). Detail out = General department (8,798,168) (p22) + Capital Projects (106,082) (p19) + Sinking (59,244) + TIF (17,326) (pp20-21) = 8,980,820. Excess (8,798,168 - 2,193,955) + (76,570 - 23,270) = 6,604,213 + 53,300 = 6,657,513 = gap; the same amounts appear on the transfers_in side, so net transfers agree (-101,634). No fix.
